# SaaS-UI

> Local-first visual editor for design systems. MIT licensed, frontend-only, no account required.

## What it is

SaaS-UI is a local-first editor for design tokens: colors, typography, layout, components,
effects, motion, assets, AI rules, and exports. Projects are stored in the browser with
IndexedDB. The editor works offline and never requires the hosted cloud to start, edit, or
export a local design system.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/BlackBenAI/saas-ui)
- [Hosted edition](https://saasui.cloud)

## Key facts

- React 18 + Vite 5 + TypeScript.
- Zustand state, Dexie/IndexedDB persistence, 700 ms autosave.
- Ten editor modules; Overview is implemented, the other modules are being completed.
- No account, no API, no cloud dependency in the open-source build.
- The hosted edition adds accounts, cloud sync, collaboration, billing, and administration.
